notes: Tier 2. Researched from public ally.com help pages only (no sign-in). Ally Bank's consumer bill is the Ally auto loan (Ally Bank is the lender; the loans-category record ally-auto-ally-financial-5ac266 has its own dossier for the same servicing pages, re-checked here on 2026-10-10). Online payments from checking or savings are free; a one-time debit card payment goes through CheckFreePay for $3.75 and ACI Pay phone payments cost $4 (third parties). Auto Pay draws checking or savings on a chosen day (29th-31st falls to the month's last day) and can be cancelled until 3 pm ET on the payment date; Direct Pay is a legacy program. Mail: Payment Processing Center, P.O. Box 71119, Charlotte, NC 28272-1119. Online statements are the default after creating a username and password; 12 months viewable; paper statements arrive about 19 days before the due date. Payment extensions are finalized by making the quoted payment; the online request flow is not publicly described (payment_arrangement inferred, as in the Ally Auto dossier). Sign-in: Username + password (documented on the account information page).

help.title: Ways to pay your Ally auto loan
paragraphs: Log in, pick your vehicle and choose Make a Payment to pay from a checking or savings account at no cost. A one-time debit card payment is handled by CheckFreePay, a third party that adds a $3.75 fee to the payment.

By phone, call 1-888-925-2559, or use ACI Pay at 1-888-631-8930 (a third party that adds a $4 fee). By mail, send your payment with your name and account number to Payment Processing Center, P.O. Box 71119, Charlotte, NC 28272-1119.

help.title: Auto Pay
paragraphs: Auto Pay withdraws your payment from checking or savings each month on the day you pick. If you pick the 29th, 30th or 31st and a month is shorter, the payment is applied on the last day of that month.

To enroll, log in, choose your vehicle, then Payments and Enroll in Auto Pay. Change or cancel it any time before 3 pm ET on the scheduled payment date. Customers in the older Direct Pay program must cancel it first; Direct Pay cannot be restarted once cancelled.

help.title: Payment extensions
paragraphs: A payment extension moves one or more payments to later in your contract. You finalize it by making the quoted payment and agreeing to the terms. The number of extensions is limited and a processed extension cannot be cancelled. Call 1-888-925-2559 or chat with Ally to talk through options.

help.title: Statements and paperless
paragraphs: Online statements are on by default once you set up your username and password. View up to 12 months under Documents, then Statements. To also get paper statements, go to Profile and Settings and choose Paperless Settings. Mailed statements arrive about 19 days before the due date.
